description: A two-seater sofa with a modern design. It features deep button tufting on the back cushions, creating a classic yet contemporary look. The seat cushions are also tufted, providing a comfortable and plush feel. Integrated armrests are complemented by two cylindrical bolster pillows, adding a touch of elegance and extra support. The sofa is upholstered in a textured teal fabric, giving it a rich and inviting appearance. It stands on four tapered wooden legs, contributing to its overall sleek silhouette. The clean lines and compact size make it a versatile piece suitable for various living spaces.
